[RAOT.3.2] The slot table is a sequence of pointer-sized
zero-filled slots (8 bytes on 64-bit architectures).  The machine
code follows immediately.  For ALPHA_TEST and JOIN_TEST bodies the
slot table is empty (0 bytes) — these functions are pure predicates
with no external calls.  For RHS bodies the slot table size is fixed
per architecture (RAOT.5).
